goals.title: Send p*-prefixed RPC args & enforce publishable key
goals.description: Send p_game_id, p_window, p_position_group, p_player_id, p_stat_category, p_last_n (Math.trunc), p_line, p_market_type for the 5 RPC calls. Drop service-role fallbacks and reject keys containing 'service_role'.
goals.verificationCriteria: rg -n "\{ game_id:|player_id: playerId|market_type: marketType" src/swarm/tools/dueloddsRpcTools.ts matches only result objects, not RPC bodies.

goals.title: Read SQL keys and empty-valid prop splits
goals.description: Read sample_size, mean, median, iqr, hit_rate_pct, home_hit_rate_pct, away_hit_rate_pct, recent_logs[]. Handle sample_size 0 / null stats with empty: true without fabricated 0% hit rate or fake sample.
goals.verificationCriteria: 0-row mock returns empty: true with '[PLAYER PROP SPLITS: <id> | <stat>] No game logs available (sample 0); no splits.'

goals.title: Read real FanDuel fields without default prices
goals.description: Read opening, latest, line_delta, deltas, snapshots_tracked from new SQL shape. Remove '-110' prices, '0' delta fallback, steam 0. Map 'ml'/'moneyline' unchanged. snapshots_tracked 0 -> empty: true.

goals.title: Fixtures, contract tests, and full verification
goals.description: Add fixtures/duelodds_tool_rpc_signatures_v1.json, tests/contract/toolRpcParams.test.ts, update src/swarm/tools/dueloddsRpcTools.test.ts, and run full test, lint, build, smoke suite.
goals.verificationCriteria: Contract tests pass against DuelOdds signatures fixture, unit tests pass, smoke test passes, secret scan clean.
